scheme_name: Nirman Shramik Antrashtriya Khel Pratiyogiyo Hetu Protsahan Yojana
other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of Rajasthan.
Must be a construction worker registered under labour law.
Must be registered as a beneficiary in the board under Section-12 of the Building and Other Construction Workers Act, 1996 and depositing contributions regularly.
Unmarried sons and daughters of construction workers are also eligible.
The scheme does not apply to any online gaming or betting related competition.
No incentive is payable if the sportsperson is declared invalid or medals withdrawn due to doping or other reasons stipulated by the organising committee.
If false information is found during scrutiny, the beneficiary must repay the assistance amount with interest.
benefits_summary: Financial incentive of ₹2,00,000 for participation, increasing up to ₹11,00,000 for a gold medal in international sports competitions.
